summary: The admitted base already implements owner/read-only HTTP credentials, fail-closed startup, restricted CORS, and stdio regression coverage. This change closes the remaining anonymous-loopback bypass by rejecting public or mismatched Host authorities and Forwarded, X-Forwarded-*, or Via metadata through the existing 401 Bearer challenge before constructing any MCP server/transport. A native HTTP regression proves GET/POST/DELETE rejection without answer/export writes, direct IPv4/localhost/IPv6 Host compatibility, and preserved authenticated proxy owner/read scopes; the full suite increases from 31 to 32 passing tests. README documents the guard and the requirement to keep tunnels in authenticated mode.
not_done: No push, PR, merge, issue closure, deployment, real tunnel, ChatGPT connector, or production-data operation was performed; exact-head hosted CI and the real remote-path credential/401 receipt remain unverified. A proxy that rewrites Host and strips all forwarding metadata is indistinguishable from a local client, so anonymous mode must never be exposed through it. Four pre-existing original-paper/font-dependent tests remain skipped because ESSAY_MCP_PAPER_FONT is unset. No new IAM/OAuth system or dependencies were added; this project has no lint, coverage ratchet, CRAP, or mutation gates.
